system.description:
Secret (notebook).

Study: a caster with 2nd-level spells; 2 weeks, DC 12.

Teaches: making a Homunculus.

The work: 500 gp and 2 weeks, DC 12; the Special Material is a pint of your own blood, and you take 2d6 damage that can't be healed until the work ends.

  • A student notebook of Faelis Orrin, Myllnoris's master alchemist, full of the homunculi he made to run his laboratory.
  • He says it was stolen, and he wants it back.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
